# Office skill catalog

This distribution contains **64 active Office skills** generated from `scripts/skill-catalog.mjs`.

## Common (12)

- [`route-office-task`](agent-skills/common/route-office-task/SKILL.md): Route Microsoft Office work to Word, PowerPoint, Excel, or a deliberate multi-file package. Use when the requested output format is unclear, multiple Office formats are mentioned, or a source set must be split by communication job.
- [`control-office-with-com`](agent-skills/common/control-office-with-com/SKILL.md): Control visible Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, or Excel desktop applications with Windows COM automation. Use when editing an open Office file, preserving native fidelity, testing application behavior, or rendering through the installed Office application.
- [`inspect-office-source`](agent-skills/common/inspect-office-source/SKILL.md): Inspect Word, PowerPoint, Excel, PDF, image, and text sources before Office authoring or editing. Use when a request depends on an existing template, source document, reference deck, workbook, or mixed attachment set.
- [`preserve-template-fidelity`](agent-skills/common/preserve-template-fidelity/SKILL.md): Preserve the structure and visual system of an existing Word, PowerPoint, or Excel template. Use when a supplied Office file controls layout, styles, masters, formulas, branding, or review conventions.
- [`apply-office-design-system`](agent-skills/common/apply-office-design-system/SKILL.md): Translate a brand or project design system into Word, PowerPoint, and Excel-safe tokens. Use when creating unbranded Office files, applying DESIGN.md, or converting web-oriented visual rules into printable and editable Office output.
- [`manage-office-sources`](agent-skills/common/manage-office-sources/SKILL.md): Collect and preserve provenance for claims, data, images, logos, and external assets used in Office documents. Use when research or external material informs a Word document, PowerPoint deck, or Excel workbook.
- [`audit-office-claims`](agent-skills/common/audit-office-claims/SKILL.md): Audit factual claims, numbers, comparisons, and citations in Office deliverables. Use before sending proposals, reports, executive decks, financial models, dashboards, or any document containing externally verifiable assertions.
- [`compare-office-versions`](agent-skills/common/compare-office-versions/SKILL.md): Compare two versions of Word, PowerPoint, or Excel files for content, structure, calculation, and visual changes. Use for redline review, regression checking, template fidelity, or delivery sign-off.
- [`redact-office-content`](agent-skills/common/redact-office-content/SKILL.md): Redact or anonymize sensitive information in Word, PowerPoint, and Excel while preserving usable layout. Use for external sharing, legal review, privacy requests, or client-safe sample preparation.
- [`audit-office-accessibility`](agent-skills/common/audit-office-accessibility/SKILL.md): Audit Word, PowerPoint, and Excel artifacts for accessibility. Use before public, regulated, educational, government, or broad internal distribution.
- [`verify-office-deliverable`](agent-skills/common/verify-office-deliverable/SKILL.md): Run the final delivery gate for Word, PowerPoint, or Excel artifacts. Use after any meaningful create or edit batch and before handing an Office file to the user.
- [`prepare-client-delivery`](agent-skills/common/prepare-client-delivery/SKILL.md): Prepare verified Office artifacts for client or executive handoff. Use when a working file must become a clean delivery package with controlled versions, filenames, metadata, and supporting exports.
